VDiR1:2t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR1:2t.text: The storm is too strong! If we keep advancing, we'll probably be wiped out!

VDiR1:3t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR1:3t.text: We've already staked so much on this, we can't back out now! I assure you, we'll break out of this storm very soon!

VDiR1:4t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR1:4t.text: Huge object ahead, course 150! Planning evasive course immediately...

VDiR1:5t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR1:5t.text: An unknown object? In the middle of the storm? Quick, tell me your position.

VDiR1:7t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR1:7t.text: Answer me, Shoukaku, tell me your position!

VDiR1:11t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR1:11t.text: ...In a radio dead zone, huh? Looks like we're in deep trouble now...

VDiR1:12t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR1:12t.text: Rats... And I haven't even settled the score with that person...

VDiR1:13t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR1:13t.text: Hold on, what's this light ahead?

VDiR1:18t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR1:18t.text: But, my head really hurts, and I've completely forgotten everything from that an instant ago...

VDiR1:19t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR1:19t.text: Rats, I can't even get in touch with Shoukaku. The circumstances haven't improved even a bit.

VDiR1:21t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR1:21t.text: No, I take that back... At least, I've finally found you...

VDiR10:1t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR10:1t.text: That snot from the Fifth Carrier Division left directly for the engraving room. What a nuisance.

VDiR10:2t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR10:2t.text: Just for how long do they intend to get in my way? Why can't simply they comprehend "that person's" will!?

VDiR10:4t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR10:4t.text: Sister, please control yourself. Since the molds are already in place, the carving process probably won't take long.

VDiR10:5t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR10:5t.text: Next, we only need to watch for the awakening response, per the god's instructions.

VDiR10:6t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR10:6t.text: Let's send out that child. Just buying time will suffice.

VDiR11:1t.speaker: Nowaki
VDiR11:1t.text: This next mission target... it's unexpectedly big and strong... Mmm, I'm not even the type for frontal assaults.

VDiR11:2t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR11:2t.text: Sorry, but Shoukaku's in danger, so I can't stay and play. Let's get this over with quickly.

VDiR11:3t.speaker: Nowaki
VDiR11:3t.text: It's a formidable target... but Nowaki is also unexpedly big and strong, too...

VDiR11:4t.speaker: Nowaki
VDiR11:4t.text: Carriers or whatever, I've sunken quite some numbers of them as well... probably...

VDiR12:1t.speaker: Nowaki
VDiR12:1t.text: Ow... Lucky ship, yadda yadda... sure enough, it's all a scam.

VDiR12:2t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR12:2t.text: Hehe, maybe your opponent just has a higher luck stat, that's all~

VDiR12:3t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR12:3t.text: Now then, tell me everything you know about this conspiracy.

VDiR12:4t.speaker: Nowaki
VDiR12:4t.text: (Whimper)... I was also one who stumbled into this 'Sanctuary'. Then... I saw Lady Akagi and Kaga who had disappeared for some time, here....

VDiR12:5t.speaker: Nowaki
VDiR12:5t.text: Lady Akagi continuously researches the technology granted by the divine right here, intending to rely on the tech to turn the war around...

VDiR12:6t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR12:6t.text: You were brought here... It's really the same as what the intelligence said about the Sanctuary. Apparently you weren't lying.

VDiR12:7t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR12:7t.text: Come with me to help Shoukaku. The more there are of us, the stronger we become.

VDiR12:8t.speaker: Nowaki
VDiR12:8t.text: I don't want to go against Akagi's will.

VDiR12:9t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR12:9t.text: Even if the gods she believes in are a complete lie?

VDiR12:10t.speaker: Nowaki
VDiR12:10t.text: Akagi is the one who gave us hope. Even if this road is perhaps a mistake, we will...

VDiR13:1t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR13:1t.text: All planes, move out! Target: Lexington!

VDiR13:2t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR13:2t.text: Pay attention; keep back some planes for self defence. You can't be so careless!

VDiR13:3t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR13:3t.text: Those newbies from the Eagle Union are no match for my Zeros! This will be an easy win!

VDiR13:4t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR13:4t.text: More than 80 enemy carrier planes discovered at high altitude! Zeroes, take off immediately and intercept!

VDiR13:6t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR13:6t.text: Quick, go hide under that rain cloud! I'll deal with the enemy planes!

VDiR13:8t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR13:8t.text: No time for overthinking! That girl, Shouhou, has run into trouble. We can't afford more losses

VDiR13:9t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR13:9t.text: I'll protect you. Remember, next time, don't be so reck-

VDiR13:10t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR13:10t.text: Shoukaku... I will definitely not let such a thing happen again...

VDiR14:2t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR14:2t.text: Shoukaku! I'm so glad you're safe and...

VDiR14:5t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR14:5t.text: Why?! Why do you want to do this?!

VDiR14:6t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR14:6t.text: If one is to wish for even more bestowments from the divine, then isn't it a given that making premium offerings is the way things go~?

VDiR14:7t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR14:7t.text: This is all for the sake of Sakura Empire's future.

VDiR14:8t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR14:8t.text: ..... "Sakura Empire's future"... Ha. How many times do you still want to deceive us with such words?

VDiR14:9t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR14:9t.text: You even thought nothing about treating your brethren as test subjects in order to obtain power...

VDiR14:10t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR14:10t.text: This accursed power simply cannot come from the gods! It will not deliver our future!

VDiR14:11t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR14:11t.text: From the first action, I vaguely sensed your intentions.

VDiR14:12t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR14:12t.text: And this time, I am furious, because you chose the wrong target to pick on!

VDiR14:13t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR14:13t.text: Hehehe, before we get to that, how about you think hard as to how to deal with the opponent before you~

VDiR14:14t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR14:14t.text: Even a soulless husk may likely mark the end of your journey as well.

VDiR15:1t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR15:1t.text: Pawns only have this level of fighting power in end, huh? Then while I'm at it... victory belongs to first move!

VDiR15:3t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR15:3t.text: Rats! There's no time to evade!

VDiR15:8t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR15:8t.text: Hehehe... So the manufactured Pawn actually picked this time to stand up for her 'little sister'.

VDiR15:9t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR15:9t.text: (A mere manufactured Pawn, for the sake of her younger sister...)

VDiR15:10t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR15:10t.text: I-is this what's called an "Awakening Reaction"? So long as the most important experiences deep in the heart are stimulated at a suitable location...

VDiR15:11t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR15:11t.text: Kaga, fall back first. If there are Pawns that display Awakening Responses, in accordance with our arrangement with the gods, prioritize making daily reports about them.

VDiR15:15t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR15:15t.text: Shoukaku? I finally found you, are you OK?

VDiR15:16t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR15:16t.text: Zuikaku... You've come... Felt like I've had a very long dream...

VDiR15:18t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR15:18t.text: That Pawn... Looks like it's all over.... Ugh, my head hurts.

VDiR15:19t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR15:19t.text: Shoukaku, I'm sorry... After so long, I've never been able to grow. I always look ahead of me recklessly like this...

VDiR15:20t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR15:20t.text: So long as you are safe and sound, there's still hope... Only then will you be able to defeat that opponent.

VDiR15:21t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR15:21t.text: Before that, I will always be by your side... protecting you...

VDiR15:22t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR15:22t.text: So long as you... confidently look ahead... only looking at that one goal...

VDiR15:24t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR15:24t.text: Go... and catch up to them... Get to the bottom of their motives. Do not let Sakura Empire's future... be undone in their hands...

VDiR16:1t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR16:1t.text: We've already given all our logs to the gods. Now we can recieve even more power, hahaha.

VDiR16:2t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR16:2t.text: However, that child from the 5th Carrier Division is still hot on the heels.

VDiR16:3t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR16:3t.text: The task granted to us by the divine have already been completed anyway. How about we go for a proper round with her?

VDiR16:4t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR16:4t.text: Your nature still really hasn't changed a bit.

VDiR17:1t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR17:1t.text: You who faked your own deaths in the AF operation, what kind of tricks exactly are you playing?!

VDiR17:2t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR17:2t.text: As you can see, this is the Sanctuary granted to us by the divine. In here, we can obtain unlimited power.

VDiR17:3t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR17:3t.text: So long as we continue to offer even more excellent quality souls... then 'that person'...

VDiR17:4t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR17:4t.text: Those things... are not so-called divinity!

VDiR17:5t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR17:5t.text: The power obtained by trusting in such wickedness at face value and betraying your own compatriots cannot prevail over her, cannot defeat that Ghost.

VDiR17:6t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR17:6t.text: Shut your mouth!!! Do not mention HER before me!!

VDiR17:7t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR17:7t.text: The future will not be found in constantly escaping like this! Trust me, there's still time if you turn back——

VDiR17:8t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR17:8t.text: All I ever hear from all of you is 'ghost this', 'ghost that'! How can I have been... by that kind of person! AAAAAUGH!

VDiR17:9t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR17:9t.text: There's no use for more words! Whether it's the strong or the weak, let us decide through what comes next!

VDiR18:1t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR18:1t.text: Hehe... O divine being, have you seen it...? The gleaming radiance stimulated by clashing souls... Is this also your desired "Awakening"?

VDiR18:2t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR18:2t.text: Beautiful yet frail... It makes one unable to resist crushing it in one's palm... Hehe... HEHEHEHE..

VDiR18:3t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR18:3t.text: *sigh* ... She slipped back into this state after all... No matter. This time's show is almost nearing its end as well.

VDiR18:4t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR18:4t.text: Is that so? What a pity~ In that case, make preparations~ Hehe... Towards the 'Sanctuary' of the next place...

VDiR18:5t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR18:5t.text: Ugh... Don't, don't think about leaving yet... I still have words——

VDiR18:6t.speaker: robot
VDiR18:6t.text: WARNING—— RETRIEVAL PROCESS HAS BEEN ACTIVATED. THIS AREA IS ABOUT TO BE JETTISONED

VDiR18:7t.speaker: robot
VDiR18:7t.text: WARNING—— RETRIEVAL PROCESS HAS BEEN ACTIVATED. THIS AREA IS ABOUT TO BE JETTISONED

VDiR18:8t.speaker: robot
VDiR18:8t.text: WARNING—— RETRIEVAL PROCESS HAS BEEN ACTIVATED. THIS AREA IS ABOUT TO BE JETTISONED

VDiR18:9t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR18:9t.text: Oh brethren, all things in the world have their own causalities. But is fate truly so deterministic?

VDiR18:10t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR18:10t.text: In this endlessly-regenerating "Sanctuary", we are always seeking another possibility of fate.

VDiR18:11t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR18:11t.text: One day, you will understand... what we do... and why we do it...

VDiR18:12t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR18:12t.text: May the protection of the myriad deities always go with you——

VDiR18:13t.speaker: Tester
VDiR18:13t.text: Experimental Station ɣ... another round of testing has completed.

VDiR18:14t.speaker: ObserverA
VDiR18:14t.text: Oh? Let me see, expiremental Station ɣ... Oh, that's the "critters" expirement logs... this is...

VDiR18:16t.speaker: Tester
VDiR18:16t.text: A burst of power born for the sake of rescuing one's kind, is it? Well, that counts as performance that exceeds projections.

VDiR18:17t.speaker: ObserverA
VDiR18:17t.text: They keep trapping themselves in their own webbing while trying to break free from fate's net. They thought they alone could handle everything, while not knowing that everything was just hypothesis from the very beginning.

VDiR18:18t.speaker: ObserverA
VDiR18:18t.text: But, is this kind of phenomenon really the mental awakening the "Creator" is looking for?

VDiR18:19t.speaker: Tester
VDiR18:19t.text: No idea. The so-called awakening phenomenon might only be faulty observation created by the faulty use of the wrong data at the wrong time.

VDiR18:20t.speaker: Tester
VDiR18:20t.text: There are still too many unknowns awaiting our research on these girls who have the "Creator's" unlimited attention.

VDiR18:21t.speaker: ObserverA
VDiR18:21t.text: "Wisdom Cubes" ...What kind of possibilities does the Creator want to seek from within them?

VDiR18:22t.text: As for now, even more experiments and tests are needed. Before we reach further conclusions, the variables need to be strictly regulated.

VDiR18:23t.speaker: ObserverA
VDiR18:23t.text: Hehehe, that too. Put all Pawns back in place, reset all machinery, raise index by 5%...... release the "key"...... Begin the next round of testing——

VDiR2:1t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR2:1t.text: Wow! They actually used the storm to envelop the waters here. Such a terrifying power...

VDiR2:2t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR2:2t.text: I suppose that those who tried to solve this riddle before already cram the seafloor. If it wasn't for my good luck...

VDiR2:3t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR2:3t.text: Anyway, I need to try to establish radio contact with Shoukaku first. This place is giving me a kind of uneasy feeling.

VDiR3:1t.text: You mass-produced imitations are so annoying! How many of you are there? Come at me all at once!

VDiR3:3t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR3:3t.text: Isn't it Akatsuki? Good timing! We got separeted in the tempest a bit ago, and I've been worrying about you ever since. I'm glad you're OK!

VDiR3:4t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR3:4t.text: Come help me drive away these pests!

VDiR3:6t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR3:6t.text: What in the world! What are you doing?! I was THIS close to being hit! Be careful!

VDiR3:9t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR3:9t.text: ...a Pawn, huh... Even though it entered the "Sanctuary" not long ago. Such great velocity!

VDiR3:10t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR3:10t.text: Pitiful and disgusting puppet... let me free you from this curse.

VDiR4:1t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR4:1t.text: That child from the Fifth Carrier Division again? She's so dedicated and so very stupid.

VDiR4:2t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR4:2t.text: That pest really came for the bait.

VDiR4:3t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR4:3t.text: Routine system inspection in progress... hehehe... all systems apparently running normally.

VDiR4:4t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR4:4t.text: To be able to handle everything within purview as one pleases... As expected of the proving grounds of the divine.

VDiR4:5t.speaker: Kaga
VDiR4:5t.text: The weak who dares to resist the strong will ultimately pay the price of their own arrogance...

VDiR4:6t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR4:6t.text: Just sending them will do. This is the perfect opportunity to "inspect" the new weapons granted to us by the gods.

VDiR4:7t.speaker: Akagi
VDiR4:7t.text: Anyone who wants to hinder my reunion with "that person" must be properly punished, hahaha...

VDiR5:1t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR5:1t.text: Ugh! They just keep on sending counterfeits to stall me! If it weren't for the storm that cost me so many planes...

VDiR5:2t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR5:2t.text: Hmm? The distress signal from up ahead... Could that be Shoukaku?

VDiR5:3t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR5:3t.text: Wait for me, I won't lose you again!

VDiR6:1t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR6:1t.text: The source of the signal is actually... Ise and Hyuuga?! You're alright---

VDiR6:2t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR6:2t.text: ...Not just Akatsuki's, but even forgeries of you two were ready, huh?

VDiR6:5t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR6:5t.text: I thought so... All hands to battlestations!

VDiR7:1t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR7:1t.text: Shoukaku! Look what we found! This is the key to the "Sanctuary"!

VDiR7:2t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR7:2t.text: This is... Where did you get it?

VDiR7:3t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR7:3t.text: Heheh, as for that intelligence, it was Akatsuki's contribution! This time, you surely can't refuse me, right?~

VDiR7:4t.speaker: Shoukaku
VDiR7:4t.text: If the intelligence is correct, we need to get moving. Call everyone together and move out!

VDiR7:5t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR7:5t.text: This time, their plot must be exposed!

VDiR7:6t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR7:6t.text: Come to think of it, maybe this trap was also just part of the plot.

VDiR7:7t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR7:7t.text: Bad seniors! They fooled us again!

VDiR8:1t.speaker: Yamashiro
VDiR8:1t.text: Dear Zuikaku, you can't go any farther!

VDiR8:2t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR8:2t.text: Yamashiro, even you have become a counterfeit?

VDiR8:3t.speaker: Yamashiro
VDiR8:3t.text: Of course not! Yamashiro is still that same~ high~ spi~ri~ted Yamashiro-chan!

VDiR8:4t.speaker: Yamashiro
VDiR8:4t.text: It's just~, I have orders to, you know. Naturally about keeping you from continuing to cause trouble in the "Sanctuary".

VDiR8:5t.speaker: Yamashiro
VDiR8:5t.text: So, please be a dear and let me knock you down!

VDiR8:6t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR8:6t.text: Since "you" are still "you", tell me, where is Shoukaku?

VDiR8:7t.speaker: Yamashiro
VDiR8:7t.text: If you can defeat me, I'll tell you!

VDiR8:8t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR8:8t.text: Are all the seniors these days so troublesome?!

VDiR8:10t.speaker: Yamashiro
VDiR8:10t.text: Yamashiro-chan's tip: They transformed me with some strange equipment! These are the designs those wooden-heads couldn't figure out!

VDiR8:11t.speaker: Yamashiro
VDiR8:11t.text: So~ Now Yamashiro-chan is very strong! I can finally throw aircraft... Waah! Why are they attacking me before I give them orders?!

VDiR9:1t.speaker: Yamashiro
VDiR9:1t.text: (Whimper) Yamashiro was defeated... even using the power bestowed by the gods didn't save me from being utterly defeated by Zuikaku.

VDiR9:2t.speaker: Zuikaku
VDiR9:2t.text: You just held back at the very last moment, didn't you?

VDiR9:3t.speaker: Yamashiro
VDiR9:3t.text: D-Definitely not! No one was goint to tell you that Shoukaku was actually locked up by them inside that big house in the center of the Sanctuary!

VDiR9:7t.speaker: Yamashiro
VDiR9:7t.text: Please save our future... those girls aren't bad by nature.

VDiR1:1at: In an infinite cycle of rebirth, time itself loses significance.
VDiR1:1dt: If not for that first choice
VDiR1:1gt: What kind of scenery is it, again?
